clips.title: The story
paras: A missing grunt named Dogran leaves Zankaja waiting in Orgrimmar. His mate has heard nothing for days, so she sends you to question his superior, Gazrog, at the Crossroads. For a warlock, the search also serves a ritual to bind a succubus.

Zankaja waits on the bluffs of Orgrimmar, fearing for her mate Dogran. He was sent to the Crossroads on an honorable promotion, but his return is overdue and she has heard nothing for days. She asks you to seek news from his commander, Gazrog. She does not know that dark arts are at work behind the search.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My mate, Dogran, was recently sent to the Crossroads for duty. It was a promotion, and he was very proud.
I was sad, of course, but I didn't let him know that. And worried, too. The Barrens is a more dangerous place than Orgrimmar, and I feared the worst.
Now it's been a week after he should have returned, and I have received no word from him...
Perhaps you could go to the Crossroads and see if they have any news? He worked with Gazrog, who should still be stationed there.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yeah, I've heard from him, but it's not the sort of news we should let get back to her...
No, he's not dead. But he is injured and a prisoner of the quilboar.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
